commentary.text: 90+5' Isidro Diaz is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.

90+3' A pass lands at the feet of Alberto Moleiro (Las Palmas) in the middle of the box, he looks up and shoots but the effort is superbly blocked by a defender. The ball goes out for a corner. Las Palmas can continue in their attacking effort.
90+2' The rebound finds Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao) in space inside the box, but his shot flies high over the bar. That was a promising chance!
90+2' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) zig-zags his way into the box and drills a low shot towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a great reaction save to stop the effort.
90+1' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle and it's Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee. Las Palmas have been awarded a free kick.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' A rebound falls at the feet of Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) on the edge of the box, but his powerful shot veers well wide of the left post.
90' Las Palmas have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
90' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man. Las Palmas will take a corner kick.
89' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders. Las Palmas have been awarded a corner kick.
87' Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar.
87' Unai Simon pulls off a great save to deny Jaime Mata (Las Palmas), who makes himself some space inside the box and unleashes a quick shot towards the middle of the goal.
86' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 10:4. The number of shots on goal at present is 3:1.
85' A substitution has been made. Alex Suarez goes off and Jose Campana (Las Palmas) comes on.
84' That will be all from Stefan Bajcetic who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Marc Cardona (Las Palmas).
84' Ernesto Valverde has decided to substitute Maroan Sannadi and he is replaced by Gorka Guruzeta (Ath Bilbao).
84' The manager makes a subsitution with Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) coming on for Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta.
81' Ath Bilbao are ruled offside.
80' Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) fires a rebound from mid-range onto the bar!
80' Viti (Las Palmas) delivers a promising cross into the box, but it's cleared.
78' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Las Palmas.
77' It's like he was asking for a caution. Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) receives a yellow card.
75' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
74' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
74' Diego Martinez is forced to make a change. Marvin is unable to continue due to injury, Adnan Januzaj (Las Palmas) comes on.
73' Dangerous play by Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao). Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul. It's a free kick to Las Palmas in a dangerous position.
73' Marvin (Las Palmas) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
72' The game is interrupted now, Marvin (Las Palmas) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
70' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) looks to break free, but his touch lets him down and he loses the ball. The ball goes out of play and Las Palmas will have a goal kick.
68' Great save! Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Dinko Horkas.
67' What a big chance! Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao) picks up an inch-perfect pass inside the box and fires the ball a whisker wide of the right post.
65' Here is a change. Alex Berenguer is going off and Ernesto Valverde gives the last tactical orders to Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao).
65' Diego Martinez prepares a substitution. Oliver McBurnie is replaced by Manuel Fuster (Las Palmas).
65' Here comes a substitution. Sandro Ramirez is given a rest as he is replaced by Jaime Mata (Las Palmas).
63' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle after Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) kicks an opponent's legs instead of the ball. Free kick. Ath Bilbao will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
63' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) is offside and the linesman raises his flag.
62' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
57' It could have been a good chance to score! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to release Maroan Sannadi with a through ball as the defence is alert and clears.
53' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) was quite harsh and Isidro Diaz didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
53' Alex Berenguer slings over a decent looking cross towards Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao), who outjumps his marker in the middle of the box but sends a poor header high over the bar.

50' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly low towards the middle of the goal, but Dinko Horkas is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
48' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) connects with a cross from out wide in the six-yard box, but only plants his header onto the bar.
48' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.

45+1' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The ball is out of play. A goal-scoring opportunity from a corner for Ath Bilbao.
45+1' The game is interrupted as Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) is flagged offside.
45' We will have 2 min. of added time.
45' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul after Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) hacks down one of his opponents. Las Palmas will take a free kick near the side line.
44' Dinko Horkas displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
42' Marvin (Las Palmas) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Ath Bilbao.

42' Poor challenge! Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is penalised for tripping and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle. It's a free kick to Las Palmas, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
39' Nothing comes of the resulting corner from Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao). The defence is alert and manages to cut it out.
39' Oscar de Marcos (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. Ath Bilbao earn a corner.
37' Oliver McBurnie (Las Palmas) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot low towards the middle of the goal was comfortably saved by Unai Simon.
35' The linesman raises his flag for offside before Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) heads on.
32' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
30' Looks like Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
29' The free kick is taken by Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao), but ball is cleared.

28' Isidro Diaz blows his whistle after Alex Suarez (Las Palmas) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle. It's a free kick to Ath Bilbao, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.

27' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) brings his opponent down with a tackle and Isidro Diaz blows his whistle for a foul. The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) for a foul that he committed a little earlier. A free kick has been awarded to Ath Bilbao.

25' Maroan Sannadi (Ath Bilbao) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team. A free kick has been awarded to Las Palmas.
22' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Oihan Sancet leaves the pitch to be replaced by Peio Canales (Ath Bilbao).
21' Ath Bilbao take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
20' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao). Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
19' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) is being forced to leave the pitch in order to receive medical treatment and his team will play with a man short for a few minutes.
15' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it fails to bother the goalkeeper as it hits the defensive wall.
15' Stefan Bajcetic (Las Palmas) jumps into a tackle and Isidro Diaz signals a foul. Ath Bilbao earn a free kick which could lead to a goal-scoring opportunity.
13' Dario Essugo (Las Palmas) got the ball on the edge of the box and smashed a first-time shot, but his effort flew high over the crossbar.
12' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Las Palmas, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
11' The game has begun to heat up. Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) challenges an opponent and receives a deserved yellow card for his ugly tackle.
10' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Ath Bilbao, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
10' Sandro Ramirez (Las Palmas) trips an opposition player and Isidro Diaz signals a foul. Ath Bilbao are awarded a free kick.
9' Great teamplay by Ath Bilbao as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.

5' 1 - 0 Goal! Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) beautifully controls a strongly hit pass from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta inside the box. He cuts inside his marker and rifles the ball low into the middle of the goal. 1:0.
